bayley4_overview.content: Bayley Scales of Infant and Toddler Development - Fourth Edition (Bayley-4)

assessment_summary.content: The Bayley-4 assessment was administered to evaluate Sabrina's developmental functioning across cognitive, language, motor, social-emotional, and adaptive behavior domains. The assessment provides standardized scores that allow comparison to same-age peers and identification of areas of strength and need.

cognitive_domain.content: In the Cognitive domain, Sabrina achieved a scaled score of 8, which falls within the average range (25th percentile), indicating age-appropriate cognitive development. Performance in this domain reflects Sabrina's ability to problem-solve, explore her environment actively, and demonstrate emerging early learning skills such as object permanence and simple cause-and-effect understanding.

language_domains.content: Language assessment revealed receptive communication scored at a scaled score of 7, placing her in the below-average range (16th percentile), indicating some delays in language comprehension skills. Expressive communication obtained a scaled score of 6, classified in the below-average range (10th percentile), suggesting a delay in verbal expression skills. These results suggest that Sabrina is currently trailing behind developmental expectations in language acquisition and expressive communication.

motor_domains.content: Motor evaluation demonstrated fine motor skills with a scaled score of 9, categorized in the average range (37th percentile), showing the ability to manipulate small objects moderately well. Gross motor assessment reported a scaled score of 8, also within the average range (25th percentile), reflecting relatively age-appropriate gross motor abilities, such as crawling and sitting with support.

social_emotional_adaptive.content: Social-emotional and adaptive behavior assessment indicated that Sabrina performs at an average level, with a scaled score of 10 (50th percentile), in social-emotional development. This domain showcases Sabrina's ability to interact socially, engage with caregivers, and begin to develop emotional regulation consistent with her age. Adaptive behavior, as per her caregiver's report, was age-appropriate, suggesting that Sabrina is able to participate in basic self-care activities with assistance.

content: Sabrina exhibits strengths in gross and fine motor domains, indicating potential areas to focus on enhancing her environment exploration skills.
Targeted intervention is recommended in the language domain to support both receptive and expressive communication.
Continued monitoring of cognitive and social-emotional domains in routine interventions to support holistic development.
Recommend collaboration with family to incorporate language-rich activities and play-based interventions to encourage communication skills at home.
